profile.name: Florian Guichard
profile.tagline: I design and deploy AI agents and automation workflows for SMEs, from use case discovery through to production.
profile.bio:
Engineer with a Master's degree in computer science (IMERIR, cybersecurity track), I have specialised in generative AI and automation for the past 4 years. I now support SMEs on these topics, from the first conversation through to deployment.

Day to day, I design AI agents (OpenAI/REST APIs) and no-code workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate) to connect their tools and take repetitive work off their hands.

Trained in cybersecurity and attentive to GDPR requirements, I know how to make technical topics accessible for non-technical stakeholders. I am actively upskilling in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and in agentic architectures (RAG, multi-agent orchestration). Fluent English.

search.title: What I'm looking for
search.text: A role as an Agentic AI & Automation Consultant, where I can put to good use my experience in building AI agents, automating workflows and advising clients, while continuing to grow in cloud environments and in industrialising agentic AI solutions for production.

experience.description: Design and development of AI agents (OpenAI/REST APIs) and no-code automation workflows (n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate) to connect information systems, business applications and repetitive tasks, for over 60 SMEs. Individual support to businesses in identifying generative AI and cybersecurity use cases, from scoping the need through to operational implementation. Design of teaching materials and delivery of many hands-on workshops on generative AI and automation, training non-technical audiences on their own business use cases.

Development and maintenance of office and web solutions (Python, SQL, Bash), ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the internal information system. Creation of video content and teaching guides to strengthen digital communication and make digital tools easier to adopt.
Optimisation of an e-commerce platform through the development of web features and the analysis of user data, improving overall conversion performance.

items.name: AI agents via OpenAI / REST API

projects.title: AgentHub — Multi-agent AI SaaS platform
projects.description: Multi-agent AI SaaS platform for SMEs: orchestrates AI agents to automate business tasks. Built with FastAPI and Next.js.
detail: AgentHub is a SaaS platform that lets SMEs create and orchestrate several AI agents: lead qualification, customer support, follow-up, document summarisation… Each agent is configurable, and an orchestration queue coordinates their execution according to business scenarios.

My role: multi-agent architecture design, implementation of the orchestration and workflows, and platform deployment. The code is developed with a vibe coding approach — I handle design, architecture and review, and rely on a coding agent to speed up implementation.
Stack: FastAPI (Python) on the back end, Next.js on the front end.

Work in progress, not finished: orchestration and the back-end API are functional, and the front end is already well advanced (dashboard, agent editing, multi-agent chat with memory, dark theme). The code is public on GitHub, so the implementation can be read rather than taken on trust.

projects.title: Radar — Competitive price monitoring
projects.description: Tool for monitoring competitors' prices, availability and promotions, helping businesses track their market positioning.
detail: Competitive intelligence SaaS: price, availability and promotion monitoring, change detection and email alerts.
Stack: FastAPI (SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, Pydantic v2), Redis + RQ (async workers), Playwright (JS sites), PostgreSQL, Next.js 16 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind). Docker Compose + 121 pytest tests.
JWT authentication, CSV import/export, Stripe billing, administration. Developed with a vibe coding approach (design, architecture and review handled by me).
Work in progress, not finished — currently extending the coverage of scraping extractors.

projects.title: qraft — QR code generator with analytics
projects.description: Web platform for generating QR codes (URL or vCard) with user accounts, a personal library and scan analytics.
detail: qraft generates QR codes from a URL or a vCard 3.0, with live preview, colour customisation and PNG 1024 px or vector SVG export. Every saved QR code is linked to a tracking URL that records the scan before redirecting to the destination.

Scan analytics aggregate the number of scans, the trend over 30 days, the latest scan, the device type and the referrer domain, with aggregate reconciliation on startup and purging of raw events beyond 365 days.

Security: passwords hashed with scrypt and a random salt, HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict session cookies storing only the hash, CSRF tokens, prepared SQL queries, rate limiting, CSP and HSTS headers, and rejection of URLs containing credentials or pointing to private networks.
Written in JavaScript on Node.js 22 using the native node:sqlite module and with no npm dependencies, with an integration test suite that starts an isolated server on a temporary database.

Work in progress, not finished: the platform works locally but is not ready for public deployment. Still to do: email address verification, password reset, encrypted backups, rate limiting shared across instances, migration to PostgreSQL and moderation of destinations. Scan tracking also requires a public HTTPS origin to be configured.

projects.title: Generative AI training — 3 formats
projects.description: Introductory course, advanced workshop and conferences on generative AI for non-technical audiences: concepts, business use cases, ethical limits and live demonstrations.

My role: designing the materials, delivering them, live demonstrations, guided exercises on real use cases, and discussion of limits, ethics and GDPR.
Format: small groups, adapted materials, each participant builds their own automations during the workshop.
Organisations not named: references available in an interview.
